summaryEn: WPP CEO Mark Read presses Musk on stage at Cannes Lions about telling advertisers to "go f**k yourself", brand safety on X, and how AI is reshaping creativity and business.
summaryZh: WPP首席执行官马克·里德在戛纳国际创意节的舞台上就马斯克叫广告商“去你妈的”、X上的品牌安全，以及人工智能如何重塑创意和商业等问题向他追问。
